level.label: Level
level.hover: The overall loudness of the sound. Range 0.1 to 4.

speak.label: Speaks at
speak.hover: The pressure where the tone starts to speak. Range 0.03 to 0.5.

dyn.label: Dynamics
dyn.hover: How hard the breath drives the tone at a full press: higher is louder and rougher. Range 0.4 to 1.5.

attack.label: Breath response
attack.hover: How quickly the breath follows the key: higher is slower and smoother. Range 0.5 to 60 ms.

dyn_gain.label: Loudness by breath
dyn_gain.hover: How much the loudness follows the breath on top of the tone itself: 0 only the tone changes, 1 the level too. Range 0 to 1.

tongue.label: Strike
tongue.hover: How much a fast strike kicks the breath at the start of the note. Range 0 to 1.

tongue_noise.label: Tongue noise
tongue_noise.hover: How much "t" a hard strike adds at the start of the note. Range 0 to 2.

reed_open.label: Reed opening
reed_open.hover: How open the reed rests: looser is louder and freer. Range 0.08 to 0.7.

reed_freq.label: Reed resonance
reed_freq.hover: Where the reed's own resonance sits. Range 1500 to 8000 Hz.

reed_damp.label: Reed damping
reed_damp.hover: How much the lips damp the reed. Range 0.2 to 1.5.

loss.label: Bore loss
loss.hover: How much of the wave the tube reflects: lower is more damped. Range 0.9 to 0.995.

lattice.label: Tone-hole cutoff
lattice.hover: The frequency above which the open tone holes stop reflecting: the wind tone's brightness. Range 300 to 6000 Hz.

lat_breath.label: Cutoff by breath
lat_breath.hover: How many octaves brighter the tone-hole cutoff gets with pressure. Range 0 to 1.5 octaves.

apex.label: Cone apex
apex.hover: The cone's apex as a share of the period at the lowest note. Range 0.15 to 0.5.

apex_lp.label: Apex tone
apex_lp.hover: How dark the cone's apex reflection is, in multiples of the fundamental. Range 1.5 to 20.

jet.label: Jet timing
jet.hover: The flute jet's travel time as a fraction of the period. Range 0.4 to 0.6.

jet_off.label: Jet offset
jet_off.hover: How far the flute jet aims off the edge: adds even harmonics. Range 0 to 0.8.

body.label: Body
body.hover: How much of the wave inside the tube is mixed into the radiated sound. Range 0 to 3.

rad_hp.label: Radiation low cut
rad_hp.hover: The frequency below which the instrument radiates less. Range 20 to 2000 Hz.

bright.label: Brightness
bright.hover: The brightness of the tone: the frequency above which it rolls off. Range 500 to 16000 Hz.

br_breath.label: Brightness by breath
br_breath.hover: How much brighter the tone gets with pressure. Range 0 to 8.

f1_hz.label: Formant 1 frequency
f1_hz.hover: Where the first formant sits. Range 150 to 5000 Hz.

f1_db.label: Formant 1 level
f1_db.hover: How much the first formant is boosted or cut. Range -12 to 15 dB.

f2_hz.label: Formant 2 frequency
f2_hz.hover: Where the second formant sits. Range 300 to 8000 Hz.

f2_db.label: Formant 2 level
f2_db.hover: How much the second formant is boosted or cut. Range -12 to 15 dB.

f_q.label: Formant sharpness
f_q.hover: How narrow the formants are. Range 0.5 to 6.

breath.label: Breath noise
breath.hover: The audible breath in the tone. Range 0 to 3.

turb.label: Turbulence
turb.hover: The turbulence in the air stream. Range 0 to 0.15.

noise_hz.label: Breath noise centre
noise_hz.hover: Where the breath noise sits. Range 300 to 8000 Hz.

tilt_bright.label: Brightness by timbre
tilt_bright.hover: How much timbre brightens the embouchure. Range 0 to 1.

tilt_breath.label: Breathiness by timbre
tilt_breath.hover: How much breathiness and subtone timbre below its centre adds. Range 0 to 1.

growl.label: Growl
growl.hover: The depth of the throaty growl when the note is pushed hard: 0 off. Range 0 to 0.8.

growl_from.label: Growl from
growl_from.hover: The pressure where the growl sets in. Range 0.5 to 1.5.

vib.label: Vibrato
vib.hover: The depth of the automatic vibrato. Range 0 to 0.6 semitones.

vib_hz.label: Vibrato rate
vib_hz.hover: How fast the vibrato wavers. Range 2 to 8 Hz.

vib_breath.label: Breath vibrato
vib_breath.hover: How much the loudness wavers with the vibrato. Range 0 to 0.3.

life.label: Life
life.hover: Micro-randomness: 0 every note identical, 1 each one slightly different. Range 0 to 1.

instrument.label: Instrument
instrument.hover: Which instrument: clarinet, bass clarinet, soprano, alto, tenor or baritone sax, oboe, bassoon or flute. Range steps 0 to 8.
